s.note: Sardine toasts with lemon butter and pickled shallot, served at room temperature.
s.how: Warm the vinegar with the sugar and a pinch of salt, pour over the shallots and leave to pickle. Mash the butter with the lemon zest and a pinch of pepper. Toast the rye and spread with the lemon butter. Lay the sardines on top, squeeze over a little lemon and finish with shallots and dill.
shop: 2 x 110g tins sardines in olive oil@Seafood

s.note: Roast marrow bones scooped onto toast with caper salad.
s.how: Pat the bones dry, season and stand them cut side up on a tray. Roast at 220C until the marrow is soft and just starting to bubble. Toss the parsley, shallot and capers with the oil and lemon juice. Toast the bread and serve with the bones, the salad and salt for scooping and spreading.

s.note: Paprika yolks, crisp bacon, chives. Art eats everything in Ray's fridge.
s.how: Lower the eggs into boiling water, cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel. Fry the bacon until crisp, then crumble. Halve the eggs, mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard and vinegar and season well. Pipe or spoon back in and finish with paprika, bacon and chives.

m.note: Slow-cooked beef goulash, sour cream, noodles.
m.how: Toss the beef in the flour and brown it hard in the oil in batches. Soften the onions and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste for a minute. Return the beef with the capsicum and stock, cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart. Boil the noodles, drain and toss with the butter and parsley. Serve the goulash over the noodles with a spoon of sour cream.

m.note: Pepperoni, mozzarella, chilli flakes. Ricky called the pizza dude for the show.
m.how: Mix the tomatoes, garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt for the sauce. Stretch the dough into 2 large rounds on oiled trays. Spread with sauce, cover with mozzarella and pepperoni and bake at 250C until blistered. Warm the honey with the chilli, drizzle over and finish with parmesan.

w.note: There go the brownies. Fudgy walnut brownies, caramel sauce.
w.how: Melt the chocolate and butter, then beat in the sugar and the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, cocoa, walnuts and a pinch of salt and spread in a lined 20cm tin. Swirl spoonfuls of the caramel through the top and bake at 170C until just set. Cool, cut into squares and serve with softly whipped cream.

d.note: Iced coffee floats with vanilla ice cream, mind your lap.
d.how: Stir the cold brew, milk and maple syrup together. Half fill 4 tall glasses with ice and pour in the coffee. Float 2 scoops of ice cream in each, top with whipped cream and dust with cocoa.

shopping: 2 x 110g tins sardines in olive oil@Seafood
